title: Packaging Highlights August 10, 1987
description: Three Archer structures including the unprinted overlap structure were re-evaluated on the innerliner machine. The unprinted overlap structure performed the best. Problems encountered on the first trial with these structures was attributed to machine problems.
note: Twenty rolls of the Nopawp OPP/foil/Nopawp OPP structure produced by James River have been ordered to determine reproducibility of the structure and to be used for longer machine runs.
